what: Which exhaustions and dipoles at the tick continue over more than one trade: every run of trades on one side and every stretch the dipole at the tick stays on one side, each on its own line, from its own beginning to its own end
asked: Greg, 2026-11-18: "how can we see with the data we have if there are any dipoles or exhaustions that continue on to cover more than one trade?"; "We need the data to be telling us what those times are"; "Go on the runs of trades and the dipole search"
nothing_applied: No type, label or kind is put on any line. Nothing is averaged or ranked. Not in the Excel sheets (Greg, 2026-11-18: nothing is applied until it is decided with him).
read_from: the stored rows, through the rows gate
calc-turn_peaks-20231003 (the run of trades on every tick)
calc-leg_peaks-20231003 (the trade leg under way on every tick)

runs.what: The number of this run of trades on one side, in order through the trade day. A label only.
Its first trade: position on the tape. A label only.
When its first trade was received, to the nanosecond.
When its last trade was received.
From its first trade to its last, in seconds. 0 when it is a single trade.
How many trades with a side it holds.
The price of its first trade, in dollars.
The price of its last trade.
The highest price traded inside it.
The lowest price traded inside it.
The stored trade leg under way at its first trade: its number.
The stored trade leg under way at its last trade.
How many different stored trade legs were under way at its trades.
The size traded in the run (a run's size adds its trades together), as `turn_peaks` stores it.

dipole.what: The number of this stretch, in order through the trade day. A label only.
Its first trade: position on the tape. A label only.
When its first trade was received, to the nanosecond.
When its last trade was received.
From its first trade to its last, in seconds. 0 when it is a single trade.
How many trades with a side it holds.
The price of its first trade, in dollars.
The price of its last trade.
The highest price traded inside it.
The lowest price traded inside it.
The stored trade leg under way at its first trade: its number.
The stored trade leg under way at its last trade.
How many different stored trade legs were under way at its trades.
How many different runs of trades on one side it passes through.
What the dipole was at the trade before: empty, at zero, or on the other side.
What the dipole did at the trade after: went empty, came to zero, or crossed.
The furthest the dipole stood from zero during it (above zero buying, below selling).

the_runs_are_the_stored_ones.what: every run found by walking the trades begins at the first trade turn_peaks stored for it, holds the number of trades turn_peaks stored, and is on one side; together they hold every trade with a side once

the_stretches_hold_every_trade.what: the stretches of the dipole, and the trades at which it is empty or at zero, hold every trade with a side once
